name: marketing-landing
title: Marketing Landing
description: A standard-funnel marketing landing skeleton: floating-bars hero with dual CTA, logo marquee trust strip, zigzag how-it-works story, terminal demo proof pane with a staggered capability list, before/after contrast pair, three-tier pricing, buyer-ordered FAQ accordion, rotating-word final CTA on a mesh gradient, and a link-column footer. Every section is an independent file so the funnel order can be recomposed; copy, logos, and pricing live in one data.json. Routing is left to the consumer.
